subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, conflicting macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by current main, or should a maintainer sponsor a narrow rebased subset?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between closing overlapping contributor work and deciding which unique UX pieces still belong after current-main onboarding changes and security/auth blockers.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Current main already landed the main local Gateway/onboarding direction, and this stale branch keeps security/auth blockers plus missing proof.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow rebase
options.body: A maintainer can ask for a rebased PR that keeps only still-needed UX details and fixes the auth, acknowledgement, and proof gaps.

options.title: Keep waiting on this branch
options.body: Leaving the conflicting branch open as-is preserves contributor context but does not create a safe merge path.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Current main already landed the main local Gateway/onboarding direction, and this stale branch keeps security/auth blockers plus missing proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged current-main macOS onboarding and local Gateway setup work that determines the remaining direction.
